Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 82: April 2008
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #82 shipped to subscribers in March 2008 (bearing the cover date of April 2008 for Issue 82). Formatted natively for Xbox 360 hardware, Disc #82 featured high-definition 360 playable game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trials, bonus DLC, and exclusive media content:

Devil May Cry 4 (stylish hack-and-slash action)
Dark Sector (sci-fi third-person action shooter)
Conflict: Denied Ops (co-op tactical first-person shooter)
SpongeBob SquarePants: Underpants Slam! (Xbox Live Arcade action-platformer)
Rocketmen: Axis of Evil (Xbox Live Arcade twin-stick shooter)
Guitar Hero III: Legends of Rock (bonus downloadable track: "Halo Theme MJOLNIR Mix")

In addition to interactive gameplay and bonus DLC, the native 360 disc delivered custom downloadable dashboard themes and gamerpics, offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews—including featurettes for Gears of War 2, Ninja Gaiden II, Fable II, and Too Human, alongside OXM's monthly Top Plays segment.
